Hi,

Quick one — I've got the BATT-312 compliance evidence review booked for 15:00–16:00 today with Chen from CellWise QA and the DG desk at Pacific Forwarder. All the relevant threads should be in your inbox already (UN38.3 report, MSDS correction, supplier declaration, the invoice issue, and the forwarder hold notice).

Thanks,
Owen
